styles.label: Weight shift
styles.best_for: Calm and easy. Each word goes bold as they say it.
styles.how: Words wait in the light weight at 62 % opacity; on each spoken word fontWeight light to bold and opacity to 1 over 0.1 s power2.out. Group enters scale 0.92 to 1, 0.12 s power3.out.

styles.how: Pure function of time. Front arch (780 wide, top 170, radius 390) rises y 1500 to 0 over 1.15 s power3.out while she frames to 0.86 about the bottom centre.
